description: Find a token on Robinhood Chain by name, symbol or address in the xroot.dev token directory — the trending and newest tokens the platform has indexed — with each token's pool, price and cached audit verdict where one exists. Use it to resolve which of several same-named tokens a user means before auditing it.

chain.description: The chain whose directory to search. Defaults to robinhood.

query.description: Name, symbol or address fragment. Empty returns the trending list.

name: search_tokens
title: Search tokens
